description:
Analyze your connected marketing data.

Ask questions about marketing data connected to Lemonado, compare performance across periods, and explore results in charts and tables. Uses the projects and accounts available through your Lemonado connection.

defaultPrompt: Which marketing data sources and accounts are available in my Lemonado project?
Summarize my connected marketing performance for the last 30 days.
Compare conversions in the last 7 complete days with the previous 7 days.
interface.longDescription:
Lemonado is the AI co-worker for marketing. This plugin brings it into ChatGPT, so you can ask questions about your ads and analytics data in plain English and get answers from your live numbers.

Ask how your Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Ads or Snapchat Ads performed. Find out why spend, CPA, ROAS or conversions changed between two periods, and which campaigns, ad sets or ads drove the change. Check Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console (GSC) next to your ad platforms. Lemonado answers with charts and tables you can keep working with in the chat.

Lemonado connects to 3,000+ marketing tools. This plugin answers from the sources and accounts already connected to your Lemonado workspace. Each client or project keeps its own data, so agencies can work across many client accounts without mixing them up.

Built for performance marketers, paid search and paid social specialists, in-house growth teams and agencies.

What it does: answers questions about spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, CPA, ROAS and the other metrics your sources report. Compares two periods and breaks down what changed by campaign, device or other supported dimensions.

Requires a Lemonado account.
